Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the primary function of the plant stem as "structural support" (weight 0.7) over "transport" (weight 0.3). While stems do provide support, their critical biological role analogous to an elevator is the transport of water, nutrients, and sugars between the roots and leaves. Option A (anchor) only addresses support, whereas Option D (elevator) addresses the transport function, which is the intended analogy in the question. The Planner failed to weigh the transport function highly enough to select the correct answer (D) instead of the partially correct but ultimately wrong answer (A).
